results.title: The Employed
results.overview: Summer. In a region of northern Italy, workers are on a construction site. Every day is the same as the next. The same movements, breaks, and noises repeat themselves as the construction progresses. In the evening, the men return home to go through their usual rituals. It’s like a never-ending cycle.

results.title: Lona's Home
results.overview: For her birthday, Lona (9) received a teddy bear she named Moka. The bond between Lona and Moka filled a void left by her parents—Mama (34) and Papa (35)—whose busy work schedules kept them occupied. Moka remained a steadfast companion to Lona until the day the bear disappeared just as the family was reuniting, ultimately helping to restore the harmony that had once been lost.

results.title: If You Were Here
results.overview: Someone once told me that you and I could have been good friends, and I thought, but we already are, just in a rather unconventional way. We’ve been friends for nine months now, from opposite sides of a wall.  I wondered what a strange feeling it must be, for two people to be able to reach each other only when the other is no longer there. As if the world had taken away every possible way for us to find each other, leaving just one door, one that could only open from one side.  How cruel of the world to offer us such a chance. And yet, I would have gladly given you my chance to stay. You, who would have stayed behind, with all those blue stains.
